title: Sewable LED
note: Each small board is one LED. This SparkFun example shows six linked boards; our order lists Leyal LEDs. Compare the actual +/− pads.
alt: Six linked LilyPad LED boards with metal sew pads

title: Switched CR2032 holder
note: Coin-cell slot, slide switch, and sewing pads. SparkFun example; verify the actual ordered holder.
alt: LilyPad coin-cell holder with slide switch

title: Conductive thread
note: Metallic gray thread on bobbins. Check the label; ordinary floss cannot replace it in a circuit.
alt: Two bobbins of conductive thread with sewing accessories

title: CR2032 coin cell
note: Flat round cell marked CR2032. Brand may vary; use only the approved holder and keep loose cells with mentors.

title: Hand-sewing needles
note: Metal needles with an eye at one end. Example set; test the ordered JNENERY needle with the actual thread and holes.

title: Needle threader
note: Colored handle with a thin wire loop. The ordered TOOVREN tool helps pull thread through the eye.
alt: Colored TOOVREN needle threaders with wire loops

title: Wooden stitch blanks
note: Perforated stamp-shaped wooden blanks. FREEBLOSS reference photo; compare the delivered hole pattern and inspect the edges.
alt: Perforated wooden blanks for cross-stitch embroidery

title: Ordinary embroidery floss
note: Colored decorative strands for Future Stamp. DMC example; our order lists BYMORE floss. Not conductive thread.
alt: Blue skein of ordinary embroidery floss

title: micro:bit V2 board
note: Small board with A/B buttons, LED display, and gold edge pads. Keep W and R kit labels with their assigned boards.
alt: Angled photograph of the front of a micro:bit V2

title: micro:bit power & cable set
note: Reference bundle shows board, micro-USB cable, and holder for two AAA cells. Compare with the delivered Club Kit.
alt: micro:bit V2 bundle with USB cable, two AAA batteries, and holder

title: Micro-USB data cable
note: Large USB-A end and small micro-USB end. Appearance cannot prove data support; test transfer with the actual cable.

title: WS2812B addressable strip
note: Repeated square LEDs on flexible tape. Read the actual voltage, data arrow, and pixel density; variants look similar.
alt: BTF-LIGHTING WS2812B addressable LED strip reference

title: Three-AAA switched holder
note: Count three AAA positions. Example has a different connector; it does not establish the classroom wiring or compatibility.
alt: Open switched battery holder with three AAA batteries installed

title: Three-pin JST-SM pair
note: Mating black plugs with a latch and three wire positions. Match the tested pin map, not wire colors alone.
alt: Three-pin JST-SM plug and receptacle with wires

title: Hummingbird Bit controller
note: Controller with labeled sensor, LED, and servo connections. Its assigned micro:bit is a separate required component.

title: Hummingbird four-AA holder
note: Kit battery pack holds four AA cells. Keep it matched to the Robotics controller; it is not a Wearables AAA pack.
alt: Hummingbird battery holder for four AA batteries

title: Single-color Robotics LED
note: LED on a two-wire lead. It connects to the controller; it is different from the flat sewable LED board.
alt: Single-color Hummingbird LED on connecting wires

title: Position servo
note: Motor case with output shaft/horn and a three-wire lead. Check the model label: rotation servos can look similar.
alt: Hummingbird position servo with lead and horn

title: Distance sensor
note: Small sensor with two round transducers. Use the labeled Hummingbird sensor and its documented port connection.
alt: Hummingbird distance sensor with two circular transducers
